title: Grilled Chicken Kabobs with Cucumber Yogurt Sauce
description: Za'atar-marinated chicken skewers grilled until charred, served with a cool cucumber-herb yogurt sauce.
steps: Marinate the chicken in za'atar, oil and lemon juice for at least 2 hours.
Thread onto skewers and grill 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Stir the cucumber and herbs through the yogurt and serve alongside.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste grilled chicken kabobs

notes: Longer marinating time here really pays off in tenderness — worth planning ahead the night before.
